title: Supplier Terms and Conditions, Kestrel Marine Spares (S02)
sections: Scope and Pricing
Kestrel Marine Spares, designated as supplier S02, provides ship spares to Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd in accordance with these terms and conditions.
All pricing for spares supplied by Kestrel Marine Spares is based on the unit prices listed in the current spares catalogue.
Prices are quoted in US dollars and are exclusive of any discounts, unless otherwise agreed in writing between the parties.
Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd is responsible for confirming the availability of spares and placing orders through the designated procurement channel.
Kestrel Marine Spares is responsible for ensuring that all spares supplied meet the required specifications and quality standards.
All orders must reference the supplier code S02 to ensure accurate processing and invoicing.
Kestrel Marine Spares retains the right to adjust pricing in line with changes to the spares catalogue, provided such changes are communicated in writing prior to any order placement.
Volume Discounts
Discount tiers apply to the total value of one order before discount.
3% applies to orders with a total value between USD 2,000 and USD 9,999.
A discount of 6% is applicable for orders valued between USD 10,000 and USD 29,999.
A discount of 10% is applicable for orders valued at USD 30,000 or more.
The discount is calculated and applied at the time of order processing by the purchasing department.
The purchasing department is responsible for verifying the order value before applying the discount.
Discounts are not cumulative and are based solely on the total order value as stated in the purchase order.
The supplier is required to confirm the applicable discount rate in writing upon receipt of the order.
Delivery and Incoterms
S02 sells all parts on Incoterms CIF to the destination port.
The seller is responsible for arranging and paying for the transportation of goods to the named port of destination.
The buyer is responsible for unloading the goods at the destination port and for all costs and risks involved after the goods arrive there.
S02 will provide the buyer with a commercial invoice and shipping documents upon shipment of the goods.
The buyer must ensure that the destination port is correctly specified in the order to avoid any delays or additional charges.
S02 will not be liable for any delays or damages occurring after the goods arrive at the destination port.
The buyer is responsible for arranging and paying for any customs clearance and import duties at the destination port.
CIF terms apply to all parts ordered from S02 unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Warranty
The warranty period for all new parts supplied under this agreement is 18 months from the date of delivery.
If the defect is confirmed to be within the warranty period, Kestrel Marine Spares shall replace the faulty part with a genuine replacement at no cost to Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd.
All warranty claims must be supported by the original purchase receipt or invoice issued by Kestrel Marine Spares.
Kestrel Marine Spares reserves the right to inspect the faulty part at its own cost prior to assessing the warranty claim.
Expedited Orders

The expedite surcharge for orders requiring delivery within 10 days is 10% of the order value. This surcharge applies when the requested delivery time is shorter than the standard lead time listed in the catalogue.
The surcharge is calculated based on the total value of the order before any discounts or adjustments. For orders requiring delivery within 72 hours, the expedite surcharge is 20% of the order value.

This surcharge is applicable when the delivery time is less than the standard lead time specified in the catalogue. The surcharge is applied to the total order value prior to any applicable discounts.

All expedite surcharges must be specified in the order confirmation and agreed upon in writing before processing. The surcharge amount is determined based on the requested delivery time and the standard lead time for the items ordered.
The expedite surcharge is non-refundable and is included in the total invoice amount. The surcharge is applied automatically when the delivery time requested is shorter than the standard lead time.

The supplier is responsible for ensuring that expedited orders are processed and delivered within the requested timeframe. The supplier must notify the buyer in writing if the requested delivery time cannot be met.
The buyer must specify the required delivery time in the order request. If the requested delivery time is shorter than the standard lead time, the expedite surcharge applies automatically.
The buyer is responsible for confirming the surcharge before placing the order. The expedite surcharge is subject to the terms and conditions of the supplier agreement.
Any disputes regarding the surcharge must be resolved in accordance with the agreed dispute resolution process.
Payment and Cancellation
Payment for all orders shall be made in accordance with the net 30 days terms specified in this document.
The buyer is responsible for ensuring that all payments are processed through the designated account details provided by Kestrel Marine Spares.
Invoices must be paid within the net 30 days period following the date of issue, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Kestrel Marine Spares reserves the right to charge for any goods already prepared for shipment upon receipt of a cancellation notice.
All communication regarding payment or cancellation must be conducted through the official channels provided by Kestrel Marine Spares.
